assign.outcome:
**Yes — full control, demonstrated live.** [Colstyles](/imagine/vary/colstyles/) answers the owner's question with seven working hooks and three complete looks, all real pages, none a screenshot.

![](shots/ink-1920.png)

**The seven hooks** ([hooks/](/imagine/vary/colstyles/hooks/)): `width:` words (click through small/hug/default/large/fill/full) · the `--page-column-*` tokens incl. pad-x/y (retune the number, no new word) · `column()` overridden into a chip wall · `index: true` (cards ARE the nav, no duplicate rail) · `bleed` (escapes the column's own inset) · `classes: "default"` (host opens with something already showing) · the drag seam (drag + double-click reset).

**Three looks**, one shared tree ([tree.js](/imagine/vary/colstyles/tree.js)): [Finder](/imagine/vary/colstyles/finder/) (the shipped default, untouched) · [Cards](/imagine/vary/colstyles/cards/) (floating panels, card shadow, margin-as-gutter) · [Ink](/imagine/vary/colstyles/ink/) (dark/bold, built from `--code-bg`/`--code-ink` so both colour schemes hold).

**Gaps found** (`doc/decisions.md`): no token exempts the drag seam from a row `gap`; core's 3-class body rule means a look overriding border/flex must match that specificity or silently lose; the token system has no plain "always dark" primitive — Ink reuses the one existing dark-in-both-modes pair rather than inventing a third.

**Verified headless:** hooks@1920, all three looks@1920/3440/400 — zero console errors, zero `.md-error`; drag-seam + full route swap tested on every look, no breakage.

**Cut:** a fourth look (none was asked for); a before/after pair for `index:` (one demo + caption said it). `vary/readme.md` still says "Three labs" — outside this task's fence.
